AgentTypeConfig.description:
Configuration for a type of agent in the simulation.

Defines agent heterogeneity and behavioral parameters.

policy_model.description: RL policy model type if adaptive
policy_model.title: Policy Model

AgentTypeConfig.title: AgentTypeConfig

AssumptionSpec.description:
Explicit modeling assumption.

Documents assumptions made in the world model for transparency
and sensitivity analysis.
AssumptionSpec.title: AssumptionSpec

ConstraintSpec.description:
Constraint specification on policy outcomes.

Defines hard or soft boundaries that must/should be respected.

penalty_weight.description: Penalty weight for soft constraint violation
penalty_weight.title: Penalty Weight

ConstraintSpec.title: ConstraintSpec

ConstraintType.description: Types of constraints on policy outcomes.
ConstraintType.title: ConstraintType

EntityType.description: Типы агентов и объектов в системе.
EntityType.title: EntityType

InterventionSpec.description:
Policy intervention specification.

Defines a single policy action with targeting, timing, and parameters.
Compatible with existing InterventionSpec in surface.py.

lex_provision_ref.description: Reference to the legal provision or lex artifact driving the intervention.
lex_provision_ref.title: Lex Provision Ref

target_population_type.description: Population semantics used for policy targeting and evaluation.
target_population_type.title: Target Population Type

InterventionSpec.title: InterventionSpec

KPISpec.description:
Key Performance Indicator specification.

Defines a measurable metric that indicates progress toward objectives.

direction.description: Optimization direction: maximize, minimize, or maintain_range

KPISpec.title: KPISpec

MechanismBinding.description:
Binding between an intervention and a mechanism from the registry.

Links policy interventions to executable mechanisms.
MechanismBinding.title: MechanismBinding

ModelSpec.description:
ModelSpec: The "How" artifact (WorldModel).

Specifies the world model configuration including data snapshots,
agent configuration, assumptions, and environment parameters.
Multiple ModelSpecs can test the same PolicySpec for sensitivity analysis.

data_snapshot_ref.description: Reference to DataSnapshot artifact (initial world state)
data_snapshot_ref.title: Data Snapshot Ref

ModelSpec.title: ModelSpec

NormativeComparisonTarget.description: Which quantity a right condition evaluates.
NormativeComparisonTarget.title: NormativeComparisonTarget

NormativeFrame.description: Formal value-conflict model used by normative arbitration.
NormativeFrame.title: NormativeFrame

NormativeOutcomeChannel.description: Canonical channels that can feed normative utilities/rights.
NormativeOutcomeChannel.title: NormativeOutcomeChannel

ObjectiveSpec.description:
Formal objective specification linking to metrics.

Preserves compatibility with existing ObjectiveSpec in surface.py.

kpi_refs.description: References to KPIs this objective relates to
kpi_refs.title: Kpi Refs

ObjectiveSpec.title: ObjectiveSpec

ParameterSpec.description:
Tunable parameter specification with bounds and metadata.

Supports calibration and sensitivity analysis.

param_path.description: Dot-separated path to parameter within intervention.params
param_path.title: Param Path

ParameterSpec.title: ParameterSpec

PolicySpec.description:
PolicySpec: The "What" artifact.

Specifies the policy interventions, mechanism bindings, and parameters.
This artifact is iterated during policy optimization while the ProblemFrame
remains constant.

global_schedule.description: Global policy schedule (overrides individual if set)

problem_frame_ref.description: Reference to ProblemFrame artifact this policy addresses
problem_frame_ref.title: Problem Frame Ref

PolicySpec.title: PolicySpec

ProblemFrame.description:
ProblemFrame: The "Why" artifact.

Formalizes the policy problem being addressed, including goals, KPIs,
success criteria, constraints, and stakeholders. This artifact remains
constant during policy optimization and sensitivity analysis.
ProblemFrame.title: ProblemFrame

StakeholderOutcomeBinding.description: Map a stakeholder to a concrete outcome channel and key.
StakeholderOutcomeBinding.title: StakeholderOutcomeBinding

StakeholderRightSpec.description: Explicit normative right attached to a stakeholder.
StakeholderRightSpec.title: StakeholderRightSpec

StakeholderSpec.description:
Stakeholder affected by the policy problem.

Captures who is impacted and how.
StakeholderSpec.title: StakeholderSpec

StakeholderUtilityTerm.description: Explicit utility term for stakeholder welfare aggregation.
StakeholderUtilityTerm.title: StakeholderUtilityTerm

SuccessCriterion.description:
Formal success criterion with threshold and operator.

Defines when an objective/KPI is considered achieved.
